title: 2022年中秋节期间上海市科技政务服务中心受理窗口对外接待服务时间调整通知
issuer: 上海市科技政务服务中心
text:
2022年中秋节期间上海市科技政务服务中心受理窗口对外接待服务时间调整通知
发布日期：2022-09-07
根据《国务院办公厅关于2022年部分节假日安排的通知》（国办发明电〔2021〕11号）规定，上海市科技政务服务中心（徐汇区中山西路1525号技贸大厦一楼）2022年中秋节期间9月10日至12日放假，共3天。9月13日（星期二）起正常对外接待。
服务时间：
中山西路1525号受理点：
每周一至周五
上午09:30-11:30（最晚取号时间11:15）
下午14:00-16:30（最晚取号时间16:15）
请广大申请人合理安排时间，并自觉戴好口罩做好相关防护措施。
上海市科学技术委员会
（上海市外国专家局）
2022年9月7日
Notice on Window Reception Hours of Shanghai Science & Technology Administrative Service Center during the 2022 Mid-Autumn Festival
In accordance with the Notice of the General Office of the State Council on the Arrangement of Some Holidays in 2022 (General Office of the SCPRC [2021] 11), the reception windows (specifically at 1F Jimao Building, 1525 West Zhongshan Road, Xuhui District) for handling Foreigner’s Work Permit in Shanghai will be closed during Mid-Autumn Festival, specifically from September 10 to 12, 2022, and will be open on September 13 (Tuesday).
Business Hour:
1525 West Zhongshan Road:
Monday to Friday
09:30-11:30 (Number taking time before 11:15)
14:00-16:30 (Number taking time before 16:15)
Anyone coming for business handling should wear a mask, and follow the coronavirus precautionary measures in the hall. Thank you for your attention and cooperation.
Science and Technology Commission of Shanghai Municipality
(Shanghai Administration of Foreign Experts Affairs)
September 7, 2022
